title: ThreadCreate
description: Body for CreateThread. Creates a durable LangGraph thread_id cursor; does not start a run by itself unless if_not_exists/create policies say otherwise on first run.

thread_id.description: Optional client-supplied UUID; server generates if omitted

skill_pins.description: Optional client-requested pins. Gateway authz: production (or deprecated+explicit) only unless caller has skills.pin_non_production; locator (lfs|blob) required when pinning; org_allowlist enforced.
